templateOwnedFeatures.purpose: Member chat page with native SmartList/SingleRow, selected native local and HTTP chat adapters.
templateOwnedFeatures.reason: The source event-chat popup includes event/group/campaign/resource navigation excluded from the template.
templateOwnedFeatures.implementation: Small component composition with avatar pill and collapse, text send/edit/delete/read, bounded history and native WebSocket reconnect. No bottom add menu.
templateOwnedFeatures.sourceRepair: Native frontend bf4760f9 persists read receipts on existing participant copies; carried unchanged into the selected local repository.

templateOwnedFeatures.name: minimal-profile-settings
templateOwnedFeatures.purpose: Name/avatar editor and minimal account settings without importing the full product profile.
references: components FormFlowComponent, ImageCarouselComponent, HeaderCardComponent, AppMenuComponent and DialogStore
native ProfileSettingsPopupsComponent and selected ProfileStore state
templateOwnedFeatures.implementation: The template form edits name and images, merges the current profile on save, clears drafts on actor change and uses the native profile endpoint. Image upload/import retains native implementations; document/audio methods are omitted until selected consumers need them. The avatar opens the selected native side-panel shell, with two member pages and a small gear menu.
templateOwnedFeatures.remaining: Notification/device preferences and account-reactivation entry UI remain open.

templateOwnedFeatures.name: notifications-and-guide
templateOwnedFeatures.composition: Native notification services/store/SmartList/converter and guide engine/launcher/overlay. Template-owned welcome notifications, retained-screen guide catalogue and member header composition. Personal chat targets use the existing page and native read receipt operation.
templateOwnedFeatures.scope: Local and HTTP inbox, read/mute persistence, contextual guides, same-user stale response guards and native 30-second HTTP user realtime scheduler. Production seed includes only guidance/localization, never synthetic notification rows.
templateOwnedFeatures.remaining: Browser push/device setup and installed/KVM environment qualification remain separate open steps.

templateOwnedFeatures.name: operator-configuration
templateOwnedFeatures.implementation: Selected native configuration facade/adapters/workspace and six action-popup sections under a dedicated configuration popup. Existing member shell adds operator-only access; local bootstrap seeds its single private configuration record once. Native guide engine uses selected controls and template API/social descriptions.
templateOwnedFeatures.remaining: TLS/host worker, signed update and live Firebase tests remain separate gates.

templateOwnedFeatures.name: tls-update-selection
templateOwnedFeatures.implementation: Retain native TLS controls and update backend/signatures. Use template-owned paths/repository/version in application configuration. Retain cryptographic protocol identifiers and internal staging filename; no Registry state.
templateOwnedFeatures.remaining: KVM and privileged host workers/package inventory selection; no installation qualification yet.

templateOwnedFeatures.name: operator-update-ui
templateOwnedFeatures.implementation: Selected update DTOs, native facade/HTTP/local service methods, workspace state/progress and action-popup update body. Separate owner name without Registry state. Keep native bounded polling, signature capability, rollback and PWA reload. Local seed starts at version 1.0.0 with no fictitious newer release. Operator-only gear and consumed notification target use existing route/guide owners.
templateOwnedFeatures.remaining: KVM, signed host installation/rollback and release publication remain separate gates.

templateOwnedFeatures.name: account-warning-email
templateOwnedFeatures.implementation: Native email selection plus minimal warning rule, Mongo-owned indexes and operator setting mount. Four seeded retained jobs; no admin Jobs UI required.
templateOwnedFeatures.remaining: KVM, installed/external delivery and source runtime follow-up remain separate gates.
